facets.description: Google Calendar refresh reads res.data from the sync path's raw fetch Response, making token undefined and token.access_token throw.
HubSpot refresh expects a parsed HubspotToken but receives a raw fetch Response on the sync path.
Zoho Bigin refresh reads tokenInfo.data.error from the sync path's raw fetch Response, whose data is undefined.
Zoho CRM refresh reads zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error from the sync path's raw fetch Response, whose data is undefined.
